description:
Remediation of technical debt surfaced by the 2026-06-30 workflow-driven assessment of the gf2 workspace. The assessment audited all six crates against the project coding ideals (AGENTS.md + @/gate/code-review) and for documentation drift, producing 71 verified findings (1 critical, 6 high, 44 medium, 20 low) across 9 dimensions: tail-masking, unsafe-isolation, bitwise-arithmetic, functional-api, doc-completeness, test-conventions, msrv, ssot-duplication, separation-of-concerns, doc-drift.

The full report is attached to this epic via `jit doc list`.

## Scope

This epic covers the code-debt half of the assessment. Documentation-drift findings transferred to the documentation-overhaul epic on 2026-08-07 so that code remediation is not gated on the documentation contract; the transfer is itemised under "Transferred scope" below.

- **Critical/high (5 code findings retained):** one task each, covering the single correctness hole (`BitVec::from_words` tail masking), the unsafe-doc isolation gap, the `polar_transform` performance regression, the CI-budget-breaking `SimulationRunner` tests, and the F_3 permanent bound stated in the gf2-kernels-hip FFI docs.
- **Medium/low (64 findings):** filed as dimension-scoped bundles after scoping with the user; granularity and inclusion decided per dimension.

## Transferred scope

Tracked under epic `fa787f85` (Overhaul documentation for research adoption), reconciled through its REQ-18:

- `44c98235` — Rewrite README for research adoption (high, doc-drift).
- `84db2984` — Fix `SparseFieldMatrix::from_entries` reference in FieldMatrix deck (high, doc-drift; rejected as obsolete).
- `12907582` — Correct surviving source-level documentation drift (medium/low doc-drift bundle).
- Rustdoc `# Examples` additions for accessor-shaped public API, split out of `aabc528a` because they are governed by the non-trivial-example policy that `3f29e945` establishes.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: All five retained critical/high code findings have dedicated task issues wired under this epic; the transferred documentation findings are tracked under `fa787f85` and itemised in "Transferred scope" above.
- [hard] REQ-02: The assessment report is linked to this epic via `jit doc add`.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every child task carries explicit, verifiable success criteria traceable to a report finding.
- [hard] REQ-04: The epic is `done` only when all child tasks are `done` or explicitly rejected with justification.
title: Technical debt assessment remediation (2026-06-30)
